Moment derivatives require the corresponding moments and justified differentiation under expectation.
An MGF need not be finite away from zero; standard uniqueness and moment-recovery results assume finiteness on an open neighborhood of zero.
A formal power series identity does not automatically establish analytic convergence of an MGF.
Products represent sums only with independence.
